title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
constraints: Each input has exactly one solution.
You may not use the same element twice.
input_format: The first line contains an array of integers. The second line contains the target integer.
output_format: Return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target.
hints: Think about how you can remember numbers you have already seen.
For each number, check whether target - number has already been seen.
Can you solve this in one pass using a hash map?
editorial: Use a hash map to store each number and its index. For every number, calculate the complement target - number. If the complement is already in the hash map, return its index and the current index. Otherwise, store the current number and index.
